## Round 1 — Major findings, not blocking merge

<!-- atlas-review round:1 layer-diff:4ae182f0e581cff4c8e7fc0b94e460d4160934a88f490068ea29d95573a1e616 -->

Atlas review of `401b2d7`, layer diff against `cursor/webhook-receiver-1b42`. **No Blocker.** The COMMENT-only invariant holds: `comment_payload` takes no event argument, `_create` re-checks the event, and `_require_read_only` accepts `write` only on the named permission and requires that it was actually granted. Body content goes through `quote_untrusted`, so planted `<!--` markup and secrets can't reach the posted body raw. The head re-check before create runs under the queue lock.

**Inline findings (6):**
- **Major** · `service_post.py:333` — GitHub sends `x-ratelimit-reset` on every response, so every 403, including a real permission refusal, becomes `RateLimited` and is retried for up to 5 attempts. The documented "403 without those headers is not retried" path can't be reached against the real API. The matching test pins the misclassification. Gate on `x-ratelimit-remaining == "0"` or `Retry-After`.
- **Minor** · `service_post.py:351-354` — the idempotency marker is trusted from any GitHub App bot, not this App. A `github-actions[bot]` review on the same commit can suppress the post.
- **Minor** · `service_post.py:285` — the 45-second attempt deadline doesn't bound the token mint (30s timeout of its own). A mint 403 on a secondary rate limit is treated as an auth failure because of the string match.
- **Minor** · `docs/open-questions.md:61` — D46 doesn't record the service's provider default flipping `offline` → `openrouter`, which contradicts D24/D25's "offline stays the default".
- **Nit** · `service_post.py:393` — the write token is scoped to every allowlisted repo name, with the owner dropped, rather than to the event's repo.
- **Nit** · `service_post.py:310` (belongs to `_url`/`_find`) — no `per_page=100`, so PRs with more than 300 reviews fail closed forever. (Correction to that comment's parenthetical: the whole file is new, so `_url` could have carried the anchor. Only the location is off; the finding stands.)

**Non-blocking (advisory):** none below this round's floor (round 1 posts Nit and above, so everything is inline).

**Still open (`unresolved_findings: note`, threshold Major):** none from earlier rounds; this is round 1.
